evidence.section: Hemagglutinin Inhibition and Virus-Neutralization Assays for Quantitating Seasonal Influenza Virus Neutralizing Antibodies
evidence.quote: Neutralizing antibody titers were determined as the reciprocal value of the highest dilution that displayed no hemagglutinating activity.
